case_finding: The read's labels ARE derived from the sentence-level annotations. `adherence_score` == (unsupported_response_sentence_keys is empty) on 2264/2264 arena rows, all ten subsets. The annotation-granularity ceiling is therefore 1.0 by construction, and the diagnostic measures what the read's own machinery (H92 splitter, documents[:8] cap, 1500/750 windows) costs a perfect entailer.
truth_field_warning: sentence_support_information[].fully_supported is NULL on 8/10 subsets (finqa 1101/1116, tatqa 658/665, techqa 1739/1917, pubmedqa 736/832 null) and is NOT a usable truth field. unsupported_response_sentence_keys is populated on all subsets and is what adherence_score is computed from.
read: R8-H101_windowed_read.py - H92 min-over-sentences of max over 1500/750 windows of documents[:8]
auc_path: R7-H59.auc_and_f1 (sklearn roc_auc_score), per subset then unweighted mean

ceiling_headline.reading: The honest ceiling for a FAITHFUL per-(sentence, window) entailer is 0.7560 pooled mean AUC. It is not an upper bound on achievable AUC: an entailer that fires on PARTIAL window support reaches 0.9444, so this label/aggregation combination actively PENALISES faithfulness. Against the 0.74 round bar, 0.74 is reachable but sits only +0.0160 below the faithful ceiling and 0.0350 above the H105-pair incumbent 0.7031 - i.e. the remaining gap is 68% of the entire faithful-oracle headroom.

caveats: 1894 of 11495 supporting keys (16.5%) could not be located as a substring of their raw document; they are resolved OPTIMISTICALLY, so both O4 numbers are upper bounds on their own ceilings
696 of 8277 H92 sentences map to no annotated sentence and are scored 1 (optimistic)
All oracle scores are binary, so per-subset AUC = (TPR + TNR) / 2 exactly

top_loss_sources.source: conjunctive support - one window cannot carry the whole evidence
top_loss_sources.mechanism: 1292 of 6173 supported scored sentences (20.9%) cannot have ALL their annotated supporting sentences inside any single 1500-char window; 1234 of those (20.0% of supported sentences) draw support from more than one DOCUMENT, so no window exists even in principle. A faithful per-(sentence, window) entailer must return 0 on every window for these, and MIN-over-sentences propagates it to the response

top_loss_sources.source: H92 sentence splitter drops annotated sentences
top_loss_sources.mechanism: sentences() keeps only >=25-char fragments and caps at 12; 1593 of 10422 annotated response sentences (15.3%) are covered by no scored sentence, and 210 of those are the UNSUPPORTED sentence that produced the label - 30 responses become invisible to the min. Concentrated in finqa (1.0000 -> 0.7500) and tatqa (-> 0.8929), where responses are arithmetic fragments below the 25-char floor

MAX_CHUNKS=8 strands 22 supporting keys on 18 sentences, flipping 4 responses. Window GEOMETRY itself costs nothing: 0 of 6173 supported sentences (0.0%) lack even one supporting sentence wholly inside some window - at stride 750 every document sentence shorter than 750 chars is fully contained somewhere, so 1500/750 truncation is NOT a live loss source on this arena
